{
  "summary": "Fixes node aborts and signed integer overflows triggered by edge-case descriptor ranges. Rejects descriptor imports whose exclusive range end exceeds the int32_t bound, computes keypool refill target bounds in int64_t to avoid integer overflow in TopUpWithDB, and checks for reversed ranges before evaluating maximum range size in CheckDescriptorRangeBounds.",
  "problem": "WalletDescriptor stores exclusive range endpoints in int32_t. Importing a descriptor with an inclusive end of 2^31-1, or importing without a range when -keypool exceeds 2^31-1, narrows the exclusive end to a negative integer, writing an inverted range and aborting the node on assertion during keypool top-up. Additionally, keypoolrefill INT32_MAX causes signed integer overflow in TopUpWithDB after an address is used, and passing [INT64_MAX, 0] to CheckDescriptorRangeBounds triggers signed overflow on low + 1000000.",
  "evidence": [
    "PR description: 'Importing [2147483647, 2147483647] produces an end of 2^31, which narrows to a negative value and aborts the node during keypool top-up. An import without a range can hit the same issue with an oversized -keypool.'",
    "Commit 867ad9bffb and functional test: keypoolrefill INT32_MAX after advancing a descriptor overflows int32_t next_index + target_size under UBSan.",
    "Commit 457c9e8999 and unit test: CheckDescriptorRangeBounds triggers signed integer overflow under UBSan for [INT64_MAX, 0]."
  ],

  },

It also prevents signed integer overflows during keypoolrefill INT32_MAX after address usage and in CheckDescriptorRangeBounds for reversed ranges like [INT64_MAX, 0]. Regression tests verify the bounds checks and ensure operations remain clean under UBSan.",

result.summary: Fixes node aborts and signed integer overflows triggered by edge-case descriptor ranges. Rejects descriptor imports whose exclusive range end exceeds the int32_t bound, computes keypool refill target bounds in int64_t to avoid integer overflow in TopUpWithDB, and checks for reversed ranges before evaluating maximum range size in CheckDescriptorRangeBounds.
result.problem: WalletDescriptor stores exclusive range endpoints in int32_t. Importing a descriptor with an inclusive end of 2^31-1, or importing without a range when -keypool exceeds 2^31-1, narrows the exclusive end to a negative integer, writing an inverted range and aborting the node on assertion during keypool top-up. Additionally, keypoolrefill INT32_MAX causes signed integer overflow in TopUpWithDB after an address is used, and passing [INT64_MAX, 0] to CheckDescriptorRangeBounds triggers signed overflow on low + 1000000.
evidence: PR description: 'Importing [2147483647, 2147483647] produces an end of 2^31, which narrows to a negative value and aborts the node during keypool top-up. An import without a range can hit the same issue with an oversized -keypool.'
Commit 867ad9bffb and functional test: keypoolrefill INT32_MAX after advancing a descriptor overflows int32_t next_index + target_size under UBSan.
Commit 457c9e8999 and unit test: CheckDescriptorRangeBounds triggers signed integer overflow under UBSan for [INT64_MAX, 0].
result.changed_since_previous: Added commit 457c9e8999 and unit test coverage to prevent signed integer overflow in CheckDescriptorRangeBounds by checking for reversed ranges before calculating high - low.
result.card: This PR fixes a node crash where calling importdescriptors with a range ending at 2^31-1, or importing without a range under an oversized -keypool, narrows the exclusive range end to a negative int32_t and aborts the node during keypool top-up. It also prevents signed integer overflows during keypoolrefill INT32_MAX after address usage and in CheckDescriptorRangeBounds for reversed ranges like [INT64_MAX, 0]. Regression tests verify the bounds checks and ensure operations remain clean under UBSan.

risk.why: Flaws in descriptor range checks or top-up bounds calculations could improperly reject valid descriptor imports or fail keypool refills for wallet users.
